label: Specification for: AMENDMENT_DEGREEOFESTABLISHMENT_STANDARDIZED
description: EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the bdqval:sourceAuthority is not available; INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:degreeOfEstablishment is bdqval:Empty; AMENDED the value of dwc:degreeOfEstablishment if it can be unambiguously matched to a term in the bdqval:sourceAuthority; otherwise NOT_AMENDED bdqval:sourceAuthority default = "Degree of Establishment Controlled Vocabulary List of Terms" {[https://dwc.tdwg.org/doe/]} {GBIF vocabulary API [https://api.gbif.org/v1/vocabularies/DegreeOfEstablishment/concepts]}
expectedResponse: EXTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if the bdqval:sourceAuthority is not available; INTERNAL_PREREQUISITES_NOT_MET if dwc:degreeOfEstablishment is bdqval:Empty; AMENDED the value of dwc:degreeOfEstablishment if it can be unambiguously matched to a term in the bdqval:sourceAuthority; otherwise NOT_AMENDED
authoritiesDefaults: bdqval:sourceAuthority default = "Degree of Establishment Controlled Vocabulary List of Terms" {[https://dwc.tdwg.org/doe/]} {GBIF vocabulary API [https://api.gbif.org/v1/vocabularies/DegreeOfEstablishment/concepts]}
example1: dwc:degreeOfEstablishment="capt.": Response.status=AMENDED, Response.result=dwc:degreeOfEstablishment="captive", Response.comment="dwc:degreeOfEstablishment contains an interpretable value in the bdqval:sourceAuthority"
example2: dwc:degreeOfEstablishment="tree": Response.status=NOT_AMENDED, Response.result="", Response.comment="dwc:degreeOfEstablishment does not contain an interpretable value in the bdqval:sourceAuthority"
